UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd clusterio && J=\"node/bin/node node_modules/@clusterio/host/dist/node/host.js --log-level=warn\" && U=\"{{ControllerURL}}\" && { [ -n \"$U\" ] || { echo \"Set Controller URL in the Clusterio Host settings before starting\"; exit 1; }; } && { [[ \"$U\" == */ ]] || U=\"$U/\"; } && PA=\"{{PublicAddress}}\" && { [ -n \"$PA\" ] || PA=\"{{$ExternalIP}}\"; } && $J config set host.name \"{{HostName}}\" && $J config set host.controller_url \"$U\" && $J config set host.public_address \"$PA\" && $J config set host.factorio_port_range \"{{$FactorioPortFirst}}-{{$FactorioPortLast}}\" && for f in allow_remote_updates allow_plugin_updates allow_plugin_install; do $J config set host.$f {{AllowRemoteUpdates}} || exit 1; done"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Set-Location clusterio; $J = 'node_modules/@clusterio/host/dist/node/host.js'; function S($k, $v) { & node\node.exe $J --log-level=warn config set $k $v; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 } }; $U = '{{ControllerURL}}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($U)) { Write-Output 'Set Controller URL in the Clusterio Host settings before starting'; exit 1 }; if (-not $U.EndsWith('/')) { $U = $U + '/' }; $PA = '{{PublicAddress}}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($PA)) { $PA = '{{$ExternalIP}}' }; S 'host.name' '{{HostName}}'; S 'host.controller_url' $U; S 'host.public_address' $PA; S 'host.factorio_port_range' '{{$FactorioPortFirst}}-{{$FactorioPortLast}}'; foreach ($f in 'allow_remote_updates','allow_plugin_updates','allow_plugin_install') { S ('host.' + $f) '{{AllowRemoteUpdates}}' }"
